intros.title: The Taipei Visit
basis: China's president made a state visit to Washington, Sept. 22–24, 2026, pressing the U.S. to 'oppose' Taiwan independence (ISW, BBC, Guardian)
A $14 billion Taiwan arms package has been delayed (ISW, National Post)

intros.title: The Wonsan Test
basis: North Korea test-fired two missiles from the Wonsan area on Sept. 20, 2026, later called a new Hwasong-11Ma hypersonic system (AP, Janes, TWZ)
Pyongyang condemned U.S.–South Korea–Japan drills (CNN, PBS)

intros.title: Second Thomas Shoal
basis: On Sept. 24, 2026, PLA Navy and China Coast Guard ships blocked a Philippine resupply mission to BRP Sierra Madre at Second Thomas Shoal, warning of 'compulsory measures' (USNI News, Rappler, Philstar)
